details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The predicted answer gives July 2025, which contradicts the gold target of August 2025.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. The gold target claims that the last month above 3,550 feet was August 2025.
2. Citation [10] reports an August start-of-month elevation of 3,548.18 feet, below 3,550, and a July start-of-month elevation of 3,555.36 feet, above 3,550.
3. Citation [5] also reports an above-threshold reading on July 9, 2025. These passages do not establish that the lake was above 3,550 feet in August; the reported August value instead contradicts that claim. The gold target is therefore not grounded.
